dataModel.section_0_points:

• Walk through the preserved historic streets of Sannenzaka and Ninenzaka.

• Stroll through the famous Arashiyama Bamboo Grove at sunrise.
• Visit the Tenryu-ji temple and the Iwatayama Monkey Park.
